title: Soft FM - Cleaning and Landscaping Services
notes: Soft FM tender squarely in the company's core. Strong fit. Contains one deliberate citation trap: a requirement whose source_quote does not appear on its cited page and must be rejected by verification. Expect conditional_bid or strong_bid.

pages.text:
SECTION 1 - SERVICES

The developer requires daily cleaning, waste management, and landscaping services across three residential communities. The contract covers common areas, external grounds, and shared amenities. The contract term is two years.

SECTION 2 - REQUIREMENTS

The bidder must hold a valid UAE trade licence covering cleaning and landscaping activities. The bidder must hold a valid ISO 9001 certificate for quality management. The bidder must provide third-party liability insurance of at least AED 3,000,000. The bidder must demonstrate prior soft FM contracts of comparable scale. The bidder must submit audited financial statements for the last financial year.

SECTION 3 - CONDITIONS

Payment terms are 45 days from invoice. Liquidated damages of 0.5% per week apply for service failures, capped at 5%. The developer may terminate for material breach with a 30-day cure period.
